diagnosis: Loopback send of 0xa5 returned 0xff (idle) with divider 64, indicating ser_tx never left idle. Root cause is the TX divider path in the excerpt: `if (reg_div_we) send_dummy <= 1;` starts a 15-bit dummy idle frame that blocks the immediate `reg_dat_we` byte so it is dropped, and the TX bit timer uses `(cfg_divider >> 4)` instead of `cfg_divider` making TX 16x too fast.
